app.title: Ckepi
app.subtitle: Causal Variable Decomposition & Planetary Analog Engine

controls.modelTypeHint: Statistical algorithm (Ridge or Random Forest) used to infer which terrain variables drive environmental responses.
controls.modelOverriddenNote: Note: In Preset or Manual mode, analog ranking uses the selected profile weights; this model only updates the causal chart.

profileDescriptions.causal_auto: Automatically derives variable importance from the statistical decomposition (X → Y) of the selected planetary target.
profileDescriptions.navigation_landing: Prioritizes surface roughness, terrain slope, albedo, and bare ground for LiDAR hazard avoidance and landing.
profileDescriptions.rover_mobility: Prioritizes terrain roughness, slope, hyper-aridity, bare soil, and thermal inertia for wheel traction tests.
profileDescriptions.isru_ice_drilling: Prioritizes subsurface water-ice fraction, thermal inertia, solar flux, and dryness for ISRU drilling.
profileDescriptions.lava_tube_habitat: Prioritizes low-albedo basaltic contrast, roughness, slope, and thermal inertia for skylight and habitat analogs.
profileDescriptions.solar_power_thermal: Prioritizes solar flux, UV irradiance, thermal inertia, albedo, and humidity for photovoltaic & thermal tests.

profileInspector.weightsTitle: Variables & weights used by this preset
profileInspector.zeroVarsNote: Variables not listed here have 0% weight in this preset. Click "Adjust in Manual Mode" to modify or add any variable.

controls.discoveryHint: Filters well-studied sites like Atacama or McMurdo to surface underexplored terrestrial analogs.
controls.minSIndHelp: Filters out Earth cells that do not meet this terrain & surface similarity.
controls.minSDepHelp: Filters out Earth cells that do not meet this thermal & environmental response.
controls.penalizeEstimated: Penalize estimated planetary targets in ranking (confidence-adjusted score)

guide.title: How this tool works (3 steps)
guide.step1Title: 1. Pick a Moon or Mars target
guide.step1Desc: Choose a key mission site or click anywhere on the 3D globe to probe it.
guide.step2Desc: Click any hexagon or anywhere on Earth to fetch live NASA POWER & Copernicus DEM telemetry.
guide.step3Title: 3. Inspect what works and what breaks
guide.step3Desc: Review the verdict, variable-by-variable deltas, or tune weights in Manual Mode.
guide.transparencyNote: Every value shows its data origin (measured, derived, or physical model) so you always know what is real telemetry and what is estimated.

manualMode.title: Manual Comparison (Variable by Variable)
manualMode.subtitle: Set the weight (0% = ignore) and minimum similarity (0% = no filter) for each physical variable.
manualMode.globalFilterActive: Global filters active in Advanced Settings: S_ind ≥ {{sInd}}, S_dep ≥ {{sDep}}

mars_arcadia_planitia.name: Mars — Arcadia Planitia (Shallow Ice)
mars_arcadia_planitia.context: Smooth volcanic plains overlying extensive shallow water-ice sheets of high ISRU interest.

confidence.title: Data Confidence & Coverage Transparency
confidence.tracked_high: Tracked zone with direct rover or orbiter instrumentation. Physical parameters come from curated NASA mission datasets.
confidence.tracked_mars_curated: Curated Mars mission zone: surface weather and dust come from Curiosity REMS / Perseverance MEDA telemetry, solar flux from orbital geometry, and terrain/ice constants from published MRO/LOLA references.
confidence.tracked_moon_curated: Curated Moon zone: observation timestamps come from NASA PDS ODE LRO Diviner, diurnal temperatures from Stefan-Boltzmann radiative physics, and terrain/ice constants from published LRO references.
confidence.mars_extrapolated: Honest estimation notice: This coordinate is {{km}} km from {{site}}. Atmospheric telemetry is extrapolated from Curiosity REMS (Gale Crater) + orbital solar geometry, while terrain (slope, roughness, albedo, ice) is estimated by Martian latitude regime.
confidence.moon_pds_partial: Partial orbital coverage: {{count}} real LRO Diviner products were found in NASA PDS ODE for this region, combined with radiative thermal physics. Slope, roughness, and ice are estimated by lunar regime.
confidence.moon_estimated: Honest estimation notice: No direct LRO Diviner products were found in NASA PDS ODE for this exact cell. Surface and terrain parameters are estimated from lunar latitude/longitude regime and Stefan-Boltzmann radiative physics.

decomposition.title: Causal Variable Decomposition
decomposition.subtitle: Statistical separation of independent forcings (X), environmental responses (Y), and physical breakage limits (B).
decomposition.breakageThresholdNote: Variables with breakage index ≥ 60% automatically trigger experimental invalidity alerts.

topographic_roughness.label: Topographic Roughness
topographic_roughness.hint: Micro-relief irregularity and rockiness affecting rover wheels and landing hazard sensors.

slope_deg.label: Mean Terrain Slope
slope_deg.hint: Average terrain inclination in degrees; critical for rover climbing and lander stability.

thermal_inertia.label: Thermal Inertia
thermal_inertia.hint: How slowly the ground heats up and cools down; separates fine dust from exposed bedrock.

surface_albedo.label: Surface Albedo
surface_albedo.hint: Fraction of sunlight reflected by the surface; governs solar heating and optical contrast.

solar_flux_wm2.label: Incident Solar Flux
solar_flux_wm2.hint: Available solar power per square meter for photovoltaic arrays and thermal balance.

subsurface_ice_frac.label: Subsurface Ice
subsurface_ice_frac.hint: Estimated water-ice fraction in the regolith; key for ISRU drilling and habitat water.

aridity_index.label: Hyper-Aridity Index
aridity_index.hint: Extreme dryness (1 = hyper-arid); ensures moisture does not distort regolith mechanics.

relative_humidity_pct.label: Relative Humidity
relative_humidity_pct.hint: Atmospheric water vapor; near-zero humidity best approximates lunar/Martian dryness.

uv_irradiance_index.label: UV Irradiance Index
uv_irradiance_index.hint: Ultraviolet radiation intensity stressing polymers, spacesuits, and solar cells.

vegetation_lai_proxy.label: Vegetation Cover (LAI)
vegetation_lai_proxy.hint: Plant cover density (0 = barren); planetary analogs require bare mineral ground.

diurnal_temp_amplitude_k.label: Diurnal Temp. Amplitude (ΔT)
diurnal_temp_amplitude_k.hint: Day-to-night temperature swing causing thermal fatigue in batteries, seals, and electronics.

nocturnal_cooling_k_hr.label: Nocturnal Cooling Rate
nocturnal_cooling_k_hr.hint: Speed of temperature drop after sunset; tests thermal survival and insulation.

mean_surface_temp_k.label: Mean Surface Temperature
mean_surface_temp_k.hint: Average surface temperature in Kelvin; drives cryogenic lubrication and heating needs.

surface_wind_ms.label: Surface Wind Speed
surface_wind_ms.hint: Near-surface wind speed; relevant for Mars dust transport and rotorcraft stability.

aeolian_dust_flux.label: Aeolian Dust Flux
aeolian_dust_flux.hint: Airborne dust intensity; tests optical lens abrasion and solar panel dust accumulation.

ice_sublimation_rate.label: Ice Sublimation Rate
ice_sublimation_rate.hint: Rate at which exposed ice sublimates; critical for cold-trap and drilling tests.

alerts.gravity_mismatch: Reduced gravity incompatible with open-air terrestrial kinematics
alerts.pressure_mismatch: Lunar vacuum or thin CO₂ atmosphere cannot be replicated at ambient pressure
alerts.radiation_mismatch: Galactic cosmic radiation flux without magnetospheric shielding

mission.title: Mission Diagnostics & Physical Comparison
mission.quickVerdictBody: {{earthSite}} replicates {{score}} of the physical conditions of {{targetSite}} ({{validCount}} validated mission test(s)). The analogy breaks down on: {{brokenVars}}.
mission.earthLimitsMoon: Earth (1g, 1013 mbar, ~2.4 mSv/yr) cannot replicate lunar gravity ({{gravity}} g), hard vacuum ({{pressure}} mbar with electrostatic dust and no convective cooling), or unshielded space radiation ({{radiation}} mSv/yr). Validate these separately in vacuum chambers and flight simulations.
mission.earthLimitsMars: Earth (1g, 1013 mbar, ~2.4 mSv/yr) cannot replicate Martian gravity ({{gravity}} g), thin CO₂ atmosphere ({{pressure}} mbar — unsuitable for terrestrial parachutes or convective cooling), or surface radiation ({{radiation}} mSv/yr). Validate aerodynamics and radiation hardening in dedicated chambers.
mission.explorationUseBody: This {{status}} site ({{earthSite}}) prepares missions for {{targetSite}} through field-validated campaigns: {{tests}}.
mission.rBreakHelp: Measures physical boundaries that Earth cannot replicate (surface gravity, vacuum/CO₂ pressure, and cosmic radiation).
